scope: Registered SceneRules callables for the exact 19-scene native corpus, resolving player-bound rule factories. This is not whole-controller, runtime, composition, panel or editor acceptance.
classificationPolicy: Every callable is explicitly classified. Ordinary gaps block removal acceptance; simulation/presentation retention does not by itself prove parameter/editor coverage. Raw reports record current source and callable body hashes.
